title: Random Matrix Methods and Systemic Risk
research_question: Can spectral correlation measures identify model-generated systemic risk beyond conventional factors and sampling noise?
equilibrium_conditions_and_caveats: Treat random matrix theory first as a diagnostic, not an optimizing agent.
Apply Marchenko-Pastur benchmarks only under defensible null assumptions.
Separate predictive content from mechanical in-sample fitting.
acceptance_tests: Null simulation across dimensions and samples

implementation.numerical_policy: Record equilibrium residuals, calibration, random seeds, tolerances and convergence tests.
